documents.purpose: Kaasalainen-Shkuratov KS3 model of Mercury at 748.7 nm, the photometric correction of the MESSENGER MDIS map products, used to light the 750 nm map.

references.evidence: Domingue et al. (2016) eq. 43 defines KS3 (A_N e^(-alpha l) with the Lommel-Seeliger/Lambert disk function weighted by c_l); Table 9 gives A_N 0.1111, l 0.5628 and c_l 0.6424 at 748.7 nm. Their mosaic test (section 4.3.3) uses KS3, and the MDIS CDR/RDR SIS names this paper for the final products. The fitted ranges recorded are the ones the paper prints for its mosaic test (incidence 5.83-87.82, emission 0.85-66.41, phase 23.42-86.66 degrees); the fit data's coverage is plotted, not printed.
references.locator: Eq. 43; Table 9, KS3 columns, 748.7 nm row; section 4.3.3
